attempts.summary: Formed a 3-node RabbitMQ 3.13.7 cluster (node1, node2, node3 on RHEL 9) with a payments vhost, an app_user account scoped to that vhost, and a durable quorum queue "orders" replicated across all three nodes. Verified messages survive the loss of any one node and remain consumable from the survivors. Completed the mandatory rolling-restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot identities and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
